playback_settings.title: Playback
playback_settings.resume_min_hint: Before this threshold, playback starts from the beginning.
playback_settings.resume_max_hint: Past this threshold, the title is marked as watched.
playback_settings.resume_duration_hint: Shorter videos do not keep a resume point; they are marked watched after the minimum percentage.
playback_settings.remote_limit_hint: Empty or 0: unlimited. Sources exceeding the limit are automatically transcoded. Changes apply to new playback sessions.
playback_settings.trusted_proxies_hint: X-Forwarded-For is accepted only from these addresses. Add your reverse proxy address here if you use one.
playback_settings.ffmpeg_check_failed: FFmpeg or FFprobe could not be started. Check the path.
playback_settings.encoder_preset_hint: Slower settings improve quality at the cost of encoding time. NVENC maps the selection to presets P1–P7.
playback_settings.crf_hint: Lower values mean higher quality. Applies to CPU encoding.
playback_settings.vbr_audio_remote_playback_uses_the_bitra: VBR audio (remote playback uses the bitrate limit)
playback_settings.double_the_frame_rate_when_deinterlacing: Double the frame rate when deinterlacing
playback_settings.tonemapping_hint: Runs on the GPU when the FFmpeg build allows it: tonemap_cuda (jellyfin-ffmpeg), libplacebo (Vulkan) or OpenCL; otherwise zscale on the CPU. BT.2390 is the recommended curve.
playback_settings.saved: Saved. New playback sessions will use these settings.
playback_settings.load_or_save_failed: Could not load or save settings. Check the values and connection.
playback_settings.gpu_index_hint: Order as in nvidia-smi -L when the server runs with CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID.
playback_settings.hevc_encoding: Encode HEVC for clients that support it
playback_settings.allow_remux: Copy compatible video instead of re-encoding (remux)
playback_settings.allow_remux_hint: Only the container changes, and incompatible audio is converted. Uses almost no CPU.
playback_settings.throttle_lead_seconds: How far ahead of the player FFmpeg may run (seconds)
playback_settings.throttling_hint: FFmpeg runs at full speed until it is this far ahead, then pauses until the player catches up halfway. A player paused for two minutes releases FFmpeg entirely.
playback_settings.segment_retention_seconds: Keep segments behind the player for (seconds)
playback_settings.downmix_algorithm: Default stereo mix of surround audio
playback_settings.downmix_hint: Automatic uses this setting, and clear dialogue for tracks titled Lektor.
playback_settings.subtitle_charset: Character set of non-UTF-8 subtitle files
playback_settings.gpu_load_balancing_hint: Each new session goes to the card with the fewest LisekMovie sessions, on a tie to the one with the most free VRAM. Off: every session uses the GPU number above.
playback_settings.pool_hint: Devices, their shares and codecs are set in the transcoding pool above.
playback_settings.device_path_hint: Linux: a render node, e.g. /dev/dri/renderD128 (in Docker pass /dev/dri). Windows (Quick Sync only): a DirectX adapter number or auto. Empty: /dev/dri/renderD128 or auto.

hardware.title: Hardware & transcoding
hardware.hint: The diagnostics check the CPU, GPUs (NVIDIA, Intel, AMD), VA-API and Vulkan drivers and the FFmpeg build, and run a short test of every hardware encoder on every device. It takes a few seconds and changes nothing.
hardware.balancing_on: On. New transcodes go to GPUs: {devices}.
hardware.no_gpus: No GPUs found. Transcoding will use the CPU.
hardware.no_encoders: This FFmpeg build has no hardware encoders.

warnings.no_hardware_encoder: No hardware encoder works: transcoding will load the CPU.
warnings.nvenc_failed: The NVENC test failed on at least one GPU. Check the NVIDIA driver (in Docker: NVIDIA Container Toolkit and “video” in NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES).
warnings.acceleration_off: NVENC works, but hardware acceleration is off in the settings below.
warnings.nvidia_smi_missing: NVENC works, but nvidia-smi is missing: load balancing cannot see the GPUs (in Docker add “utility” to NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES).
warnings.other_encoders_unused: AMF/VideoToolbox encoders work too; LisekMovie does not use them.
warnings.igpu_not_in_pool: Intel/AMD (Quick Sync or VA-API) works but is not in the transcoding pool. Switch it on below.

hardware.pool_hint: Switch on the GPUs that should transcode and assign their work. Each new session goes to the device with the lowest load for its share; a device at its limit gets no more sessions, and when all are full the CPU transcodes.
hardware.pool_empty: No devices. Run the diagnostics to find GPUs.
hardware.failed_codec_warning: A selected codec failed its test on this device: sessions using it may not start.
hardware.use_pool_hint: Sets hardware acceleration to “Device pool”. Off: the CPU transcodes and the pool stays saved.
hardware.pool_saved: Saved. New sessions use this pool.
hardware.pool_failed: The pool could not be saved.
hardware.pool_none_active: No device is switched on: the CPU transcodes everything.

stats.title: Watch statistics
stats.hint: Playback sessions on this server: who, what, when, how long, on which device and where they stopped. A play is at least 20 seconds of viewing.
stats.failed: The statistics could not be loaded.
stats.empty: Nothing was watched in this period.
stats.dropoff_hint: Sessions stopped before the end, by where they stopped ({abandoned} stopped, {completed} watched to the end).
stats.sessions_hint: Newest first. The bar shows where the viewer finished or stopped.
stats.bot_hint: GET /api/stats/summary?period=daily|weekly returns a summary (rankings of users, films and series, watch time, plays, unique viewers). With format=discord it returns a ready Discord webhook body. The bot authenticates with the X-Lisek-Stats-Key header; the key can only read this summary.
stats.bot_new: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again. The previous key stopped working.
stats.bot_example: Example (e.g. cron at midnight, result posted to a Discord webhook):
stats.bot_failed: The key could not be changed.
